abl.belfry.alarm.desc: You ring the alarm: enemies turn on you and grow weaker.
abl.belfry.alarm.name: Alarm Toll
abl.belfry.bronze_ward.desc: A bronze bell covers you: less damage taken and a shield. Repels nearby foes.
abl.belfry.bronze_ward.name: Bronze Ward
abl.belfry.chain_bell.desc: Hurl the chained bell: it pierces enemies and drags them toward you.
abl.belfry.chain_bell.name: Chain Bell
abl.belfry.clapper.desc: Strike with the clapper in a wide arc. Each hit builds Toll.
abl.belfry.clapper.name: Clapper Strike
abl.belfry.dueling_bells.desc: Four bells orbit you for 8 s, striking whoever comes close.
abl.belfry.dueling_bells.name: Dueling Bells
abl.belfry.iron_charge.desc: Shoulder-charge, bowling over what you meet.
abl.belfry.iron_charge.name: Iron Charge
abl.belfry.knell.desc: The final knell: devastates a huge area and stuns. Costs 60 Toll.
abl.belfry.knell.name: Final Knell
abl.belfry.peal.desc: A crushing bell-blow against the ground that stuns. Costs 30 Toll.
abl.belfry.peal.name: Peal
abl.belfry.shoulder_roll.name: Shoulder Roll
abl.belfry.slow_toll.desc: Three rings of sound expand outward. They build Dissonance.
abl.belfry.slow_toll.name: Slow Toll
abl.prism.broken_beam.desc: Channels a beam that scorches everything in a line. Hold the button; each pulse adds Radiance.
abl.prism.broken_beam.name: Broken Beam
abl.prism.cascade.desc: Opens a column of light on the ground that changes element with every pulse.
abl.prism.cascade.name: Chromatic Cascade
abl.prism.dome.desc: Wraps you in crystal that absorbs damage and cools your Radiance.
abl.prism.dome.name: Crystal Dome
abl.prism.fracture.desc: Marks an area; a moment later the air shatters and bursts.
abl.prism.fracture.name: Fracture
abl.prism.ice_needle.desc: An ice needle pierces every enemy in a line and chills them.
abl.prism.ice_needle.name: Ice Needle
abl.prism.nova.desc: A wave of refracted light bursts around you.
abl.prism.nova.name: Prismatic Nova
abl.prism.prism_storm.desc: Three prisms orbit you for 7 s, discharging sparks.
abl.prism.prism_storm.name: Prism Storm
abl.prism.refract.desc: You vanish into light and reappear a few metres away.
abl.prism.refract.name: Refraction
abl.prism.shard.desc: Fires a prism shard. Each shot refracts its element: fire, frost, shock in turn.
abl.prism.shard.name: Shard
abl.skir.bleeding_cut.desc: A deep cut that causes bleeding. Costs 3 Tempo.
abl.skir.bleeding_cut.name: Bleeding Cut
abl.skir.claw.desc: Two quick slashes in an arc. Each hit builds Tempo.
abl.skir.claw.name: Claw Swipe
abl.skir.final_cadence.desc: Eight chained slashes, each faster than the last. Costs 8 Tempo.
abl.skir.final_cadence.name: Final Cadence
abl.skir.leaf_dance.desc: Spin like a leaf in the wind, cutting everything around you. Costs 3 Tempo.
abl.skir.leaf_dance.name: Leaf Dance
abl.skir.rending_leap.desc: You leap over the enemy and rend it as you land.
abl.skir.rending_leap.name: Rending Leap
abl.skir.rope_trap.desc: Sets a trap that roots and damages the first enemy to cross it.
abl.skir.rope_trap.name: Rope Snare
abl.skir.slide.desc: A long invulnerable slide. Perfect dodges grant Tempo.
abl.skir.slide.name: Slide
abl.skir.smoke.desc: A cloud that slows enemies and makes you hard to track.
abl.skir.smoke.name: Smoke Veil
abl.skir.twin_knives.desc: Throw a fan of three knives. Costs 1 Tempo.
abl.skir.twin_knives.name: Twin Knives
voc.bellringer_toll.desc: Draw all nearby enemies to you and slow them.
voc.bellringer_toll.name: Bellringer's Toll
voc.brannoch_quake.desc: Strike the ground, opening a devastating fissure ahead.
voc.brannoch_quake.name: Brannoch's Quake
voc.cantor_volley.desc: Fire three notes in a fan.
voc.cantor_volley.name: Cantor's Volley
voc.ildra_note.desc: A pure note that stuns and shakes everything that hears it.
voc.ildra_note.name: Ildra's Note
voc.sacristan_mend.name: Sacristan's Balm
voc.stalker_leap.desc: Leap over enemies and rend them as you land.
voc.stalker_leap.name: Stalker's Leap
voc.wailer_call.desc: Summon two spectral choristers that fight for you for 12 s.
voc.wailer_call.name: Wailer's Call
